task_reconstruction.official_task: Plan a charging network for the US and South Korea and a timeline to all-electric.

section_map.summary: Summary leads each task with a count.
Queue bound gives the pile count.
Handout gives a ban window per class.

contributions.summary: Station count inverted from an M/M/1 waiting bound.
Country class from evenness and Gini.

dependency_graph.handoff: the station count the switch must eventually support
the country class that picks the ban window

assumptions.summary: Eight piles per station and no force majeure.
Replacement only when the electric advantage exceeds one and the gasoline advantage.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: 2030 fleet from a population regression at 0.766 per capita.
Twelve countries tabulated by evenness and Gini.

models.summary: Pile count from an M/M/1 bound.

verification.summary: Piles divided by eight recover the station count.
Classifier checked on three held-out countries.

results_trace.summary: Waiting time barely moves the station count.

writing_logic.summary: A count opens each answer, then the verdict.
A misclassification is reported and explained, not hidden.
Advice differs by the class the reader falls in.

language_observations.summary: Factors ranked by how much a sweep moves the result.
Failure kept in the record with its cause.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 6 marks the 10, 30 and 50 percent points on the curve.
Figure 12 plots the twelve countries in the two-index plane.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Keeping the misclassified case makes the 91 percent claim checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Add a third index so the United States is no longer classed unbalanced.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Station count inverted from a waiting bound.
Switch dated by a two-species model.
Country class sets the ban window.
Fleet and demand from named sources.
Milestones read from a solved curve.
Waiting time and growth rate swept against output.
Assumptions paired with what they exclude.
Summary and body numbers kept side by side.
Ban window differs by country class.
